findings.motion: SB 1174 Min Senate Third Reading (Assembly floor, passed 57 to 16)
findings.note: Voted yes on SB 1174, which bars local governments from requiring voter ID for voting. Source is the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page.

findings.motion: AB 1116 Berman Assembly Third Reading (Assembly floor, passed 60 to 18)
findings.note: Voted yes on AB 1116, which lets a person register online without a California driver's license or state ID by giving the last four digits of a Social Security number plus a signature image. Source is the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page.
